text:
Asha: Heads up — derby tonight at 11pm. Quick pick'em for anyone up for late-night glory? Winner gets the last donut box and eternal bragging rights. :trophy: 

Jon: I’m in. How are we doing picks — winner of the match or point spread?

Asha: Simple: pick the winner. If tie, tiebreaker is total goals scored. Keep it casual.

Priya: Count me in. For tiebreaker, +1 if you bring snacks :)

Marco: I will bring wings. Hot or mild?

Sam: Can we please do at least one veggie option? I volunteer to bring a big tray of roasted veggies.

Asha: Hot wings +1, veggies noted. Thanks Sam.

Jon: Also, can we do a quick sign-up so we don’t double up? I can make a tiny Google sheet but also lazy :sweat_smile: 

Asha: I can make the sheet. Quick entries: name / pick / snack bringing. I’ll post the link.

SnackBot: Order assistant online. Suggested nearby: "Bird & Barrel" wings — 24-piece hot $22, veggie platter $18. ETA ~40-50 min. Place order at 22:20 to arrive by 23:05.

Priya: Love this. Asha, ping when the sheet's up. Also who’s the tiebreaker hero — should we use predicted total goals?

Asha: Yes predicted total goals. I'll add a field for that.

Marco: Adding picks now. Marco / Derby FC / bringing wings (hot) / tiebreaker 3

Sam: Sam / Rival Town / bringing roasted veggies / tiebreaker 2

Jon: Jon / Derby FC / no snack / tiebreaker 2

Priya: Priya / Rival Town / bringing cookies / tiebreaker 3

Asha: Asha / Derby FC / setup + plates / tiebreaker 4 :raised_hands: 

SnackBot: Order scheduled: wings x24, veggie platter x1, cookies x1. Delivery note: deliver to 4th floor kitchen.

Jon: Awesome. If anyone else wants in, join before 22:10. I'll bring napkins.

Priya: Also, who’s streaming? I can cast it in main room if someone brings HDMI.

Marco: I have an HDMI cable and a spare dongle. Bringing laptop just in case.

Asha: Perfect. See y’all later — go underdogs? :crossed_fingers:
